text:
lina_cs: Heads-up — FoldLabs (onboarding) requests Osaka/Japan edge allowlist + transient rate increase for a partner demo Thu 2026-04-02 14:00 JST. They expect ~1800 reqs over ~25m. Also flagging as renewal-risk (low prod usage last 45d).
ashley_net: Copy. Do they have fixed egress IPs we can whitelist or would header-based allowlist be easier?
kai_specterfold: hi all — we can supply a CIDR and we'll send headers as fallback. CIDR: 198.51.100.0/26. Traffic originates from our osaka staging cluster.
miguel_ops: ok. For the transient bump I need start/end times, burst vs sustained qps, and latency p95 target. Also confirm region scoping (osaka vs tokyo).
kai_specterfold: Start 2026-04-02T14:00:00+09:00, duration ~30m. Burst up to 90 req/s, sustained ~40 req/s. Target p95 <200ms. Scope: jp-osaka edge only.
lina_cs: adding renewal context 12 they haven't touched prod for 6 weeks, renewal in ~5w. CS will offer an enablement walkthrough after demo; want feedback capture.
ashley_net: i'll create a temp allowlist rule scoped to jp-osaka with auto-expire and ticket. Miguel  do you want auto-revoke + fallback routing?
miguel_ops: yes please. Auto-expire + ticketed rule. Configure fallback to route to model-small if p95 >300ms for >1m. Also enable prefix KV caching for demo key to keep token spend down.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-5763: "FoldLabs JP allowlist + transient burst" (expires 2026-04-02T15:00:00+09:00). Assigned to miguel_ops.
lina_cs: perfect. Also capture demo feedback: short survey + one-pager success playbook; mark renewal status as "at-risk -> engaging" and schedule 1:1.
miguel_ops: will push rule to jp-osaka-edge, enable prefix cache for prefix foldlabs-staging, and add an eval endpoint with telemetry tags so CS can see errors/latency.
kai_specterfold: thanks. Which headers should we send for header allowlist?
ashley_net: use headers: X-RW-CUSTOMER: foldlabs-demo and X-RW-DEMO: true. We'll accept either CIDR or header pair.
lina_cs: i'll schedule the follow-up enablement for next week and add checklist: demo outcome, p95, error rate, ask for committed usage.
miguel_ops: done  rule pushed to jp-osaka-edge allowing 198.51.100.0/26 + header pair. Fallback route configured to model-small on latency breach >300ms. Prefix KV cache warmed. Ticket CS-5763 updated with links to eval and logs.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 20 minutes before start to #cs-oncall and CS assignee.
kai_specterfold: we'll run a smoke test at 13:30 JST and post results. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
